students.name: Zhao Jianqiao
students.quote: Zhao Jianqiao is a Class of 2024 Ph.D. graduate from the Department of Earth System Science (DESS), Tsinghua University. She obtained her bachelor’s degree from the College of Land Science and Technology of China Agricultural University. In 2019, Zhao was recommended to study for a Ph.D. degree in ecology with Associate Professor Yu Le in the DESS, Tsinghua University. Her main research interests include global biodiversity conservation, land use/cover change, agricultural land use and food security. During her doctoral studies, she had 5 papers published or accepted as the first author. Meanwhile, she won such honors as Beijing Excellent Graduate, Tsinghua University Yingcai First-class Scholarship, Tsinghua University DESS Comprehensive First-class Scholarship, and Tsinghua University Excellent Student Leader.
